passages.text: Lumora tablets reduce migraine frequency by 30%. Dr. Velin said "the tablet may reduce migraine frequency".
In my opinion, Lumora is the best migraine treatment on the market.
노르빅의 실업률은 2023년에 6.1퍼센트였다. 이 프로그램은 비용을 줄이지 못한다.
Norvik had a population of 1.2 million in 2020. The unemployment rate is defined as the share of all adults without work.
The population of Norvik was 951,000 in 2020.
Norvik had a population of 950,000 in 2020. The unemployment rate is defined as the share of the labour force without work.
Congestion charging reduced traffic by 18% in Norvik in 2019. In my opinion, the congestion charge is the best policy Norvik has adopted.
Congestion charging increased traffic by 3% in Velport in 2021.
Oat milk consumption is associated with higher exam scores among students. Therefore, oat milk improves exam scores.
Vitamin Q reduces fracture risk by 50% in older adults.
Vitamin Q reduces fracture risk in older adults.
In a randomized controlled trial of 400 adults, the Lumora tablet reduced migraine frequency by 30% under supervised dosing. The tablet did not reduce migraine frequency in children.
The tablet may reduce migraine frequency in adults, but only under supervised dosing.
Sales of Lumora rose from 2.0 million to 2.6 million packs in 2023, a 40% increase. The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 1,200 workers.
Sales of Lumora rose from 2.0 million to 2.6 million packs in 2023, a 40% increase. The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 1,200 workers.
Sales of Lumora rose from 2.0 million to 2.6 million packs in 2023, a 40% increase, the wire reported. The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 1,200 workers.
Correction: The Lumora plant in Norvik employs 900 workers.
Die Arbeitslosenquote in Norvik lag 2023 bei 6,1 Prozent. Das Programm kann die Kosten nicht senken.
The unemployment rate in Norvik was 1.6 percent in 2023. The programme can reduce costs.
